shows.note: Series 12 ran 14 Jul to 15 Sep 2026. Series 13 casting is open; no air date announced. The last three series started between May and July.

shows.title: Ludwig
shows.note: Series 3 ordered by the BBC on 8 Jul 2026, six episodes, filming since September 2026. Expected 2027; no date. Reports of a Christmas special are unconfirmed.
src: Chortle: BBC orders a third series of Ludwig

shows.title: Only Murders in the Building
shows.note: Season 6 moves the trio to London and premieres Tue 8 Dec 2026, then weekly on Tuesdays.

TVMaze: Only Murders in the Building

shows.title: Death Valley
shows.note: Series 2 ended 17 May 2026. A third series is not announced; the BBC renewed series 2 three months after series 1 ended.

shows.title: Race Across the World
shows.note: Series 6 ran 2 Apr to 28 May 2026 with the reunion on 21 May. A seventh series is confirmed for 2027; no date yet.

shows.title: Destination X
shows.note: Series 1 ran 30 Jul to 28 Aug 2025 with Rob Brydon. Press reported a second series commissioned in August 2025 for 2026; the BBC has not announced a date or confirmed the host.

shows.title: Heel Holland Bakt
shows.note: Series 14 ended 24 Apr 2026. A new series usually starts in January on Sunday evenings at 20:25; Omroep MAX has not yet published the 2027 date. Dutch at an easy B1 level, with the bakers' Limburgs and Brabants accents a bonus.

shows.title: Bake Off Vlaanderen
shows.note: Flemish Bake Off, autumn Wednesdays at 21:00 on Play4. TVMaze stops at series 6 (2022); later series ran on GoPlay, so the run should confirm the current series and dates from goplay.be.

shows.title: Le Meilleur Pâtissier
shows.note: French Bake Off under the tent, autumn on M6; series 14 ended 11 Dec 2025 and series 15 is expected in autumn 2026 (to confirm from M6). Good French listening practice at a steady pace.

shows.title: Don Matteo
shows.note: Series 15 ended 19 Mar 2026 with Raoul Bova as Don Massimo. Rai runs the Spoleto-set series on Thursday evenings; a 16th series is expected in 2027 (to confirm from Rai). Gentle Italian with clear Umbrian diction, good for keeping C1 warm.

shows.title: Blanca
shows.note: Series 3 ended 3 Nov 2025; Maria Chiara Giannetta as the blind police consultant in Genoa. Rai has not announced series 4 (to confirm). Faster Genoese Italian than Don Matteo, with the Liguria coast as a bonus.

shows.title: Imma Tataranni
shows.note: Series 5 ended 29 Mar 2026; Vanessa Scalera as the Matera deputy prosecutor. Rai has not announced series 6 (to confirm). Lucanian dialect on top of the Italian, Matera's Sassi as the set.

recs.note: Suggestions pool. The page shows three a day by rotation, one Dutch or Flemish, one Italian, one other, with the whole pool folded beneath; the run may add entries (Dutch, Flemish and Italian first, with where it streams in the Netherlands) and never removes one. lang: nl Dutch, vls Flemish, it Italian, de German, en English.

pool.title: Bookish
pool.why: Mark Gatiss as a 1946 London bookseller who solves murders; the same puzzle-a-week warmth as Ludwig.

pool.title: Poker Face
pool.why: Natasha Lyonne's human lie detector in a case-of-the-week road show; Rian Johnson's answer to Columbo.

pool.title: Elsbeth
pool.why: An inverted-mystery comedy in Manhattan with a guest villain each week.

pool.title: Beyond Paradise
pool.why: Kris Marshall's gentle Devon spin-off of Death in Paradise; small town, small team, one case per episode.

pool.title: Magpie Murders and Moonflower Murders
pool.why: Anthony Horowitz's book-within-a-book whodunits with Lesley Manville.

pool.title: The Great Pottery Throw Down
pool.why: The same production company and format as Bake Off and Sewing Bee, in a Stoke pottery; Keith Brymer Jones cries at good work.

pool.title: Taskmaster
pool.why: Five comedians, absurd tasks, Greg Davies judging; the other Channel 4 show a whole family watches together.

pool.title: Hunted
pool.why: Ordinary pairs go on the run from a team of real surveillance professionals; the same map-reading tension as Race Across the World.

pool.title: Das große Backen
pool.why: The German Bake Off, autumn Sundays; the same tent format in German, and Joyn streams it across the border.

pool.title: Bake Off: The Professionals
pool.why: Pastry teams instead of amateurs; sharper, shorter, and on between Bake Off series.

pool.title: Il Commissario Montalbano
pool.why: The Sicilian benchmark; feature-length episodes, slow and sunlit, Camilleri's Italian with Sicilian colour.

pool.title: Flikken Maastricht
pool.why: Police series shot in Maastricht and the Heuvelland, one case per episode; the streets are a 25-minute drive away and the Dutch is clear, slow and police-procedural.

pool.title: NOS Journaal in Makkelijke Taal
pool.why: The daily news in short sentences and common words; the model for the Readbook's own Nieuws in makkelijke taal, and ten minutes of listening at B1.

pool.title: Jeugdjournaal
pool.why: The children's news at 19:00: clear Dutch, world and Dutch stories explained from the ground up, no irony to decode.

pool.title: Wie is de Mol?
pool.where: NPO 1 and NPO Start (AVROTROS), January to March
pool.why: Ten candidates, one saboteur, a different country each series; the Dutch original of the format Destination X borrows, with the whole country guessing along.

pool.title: Expeditie Robinson
pool.why: The Dutch survival contest; informal spoken Dutch under stress, and the show Dutch colleagues talk about on Monday.

pool.title: De Avondshow met Arjen Lubach
pool.where: NPO 1 and NPO Start, Monday to Thursday
pool.why: Satirical late show on Dutch politics; the fastest way to learn what the Tweede Kamer argued about this week, if the Dutch is at your pace.

pool.title: Taarten van Abel
pool.why: A baker makes a cake with a child for someone they want to thank; gentle, simple Dutch, and a baking episode in twenty minutes.

pool.title: Zomergasten
pool.where: NPO 2 and NPO Start, summer Sundays
pool.why: A three-hour conversation around the guest's chosen clips; the slowest, richest spoken Dutch on television.

pool.title: Undercover
pool.why: Dutch and Belgian police infiltrate a drug ring on a Limburg campsite; the Flemish of the Kempen, forty minutes from Hoensbroek, with subtitles worth keeping on.

pool.title: Beau Séjour
pool.why: A murdered girl investigates her own death in Dilsen-Stokkem, just across the Maas; Limburg Flemish and Limburg landscape in every frame.

pool.title: Grenslanders
pool.why: A Dutch police officer and a Flemish psychiatrist work a border case; the two Dutches side by side, which is the Euregio's daily sound.

pool.title: Het Verhaal van Vlaanderen
pool.why: Tom Waes walks through Flemish history in ten episodes; narrated Flemish at a measured pace and the best primer on the neighbours' past.

pool.title: De Mol
pool.why: The Flemish edition of the format, usually abroad; faster and funnier than the Dutch one, and the Flemish is the real test.

pool.title: Thuis
pool.why: The daily Flemish soap since 1995; twenty-five minutes of ordinary household Flemish a day, which is how Flemish children learn it too.

pool.title: De Slimste Mens ter Wereld
pool.why: The Flemish quiz that runs on wordplay and current affairs; hard to follow at first and the best measure of progress.

pool.title: L'amica geniale
pool.why: Ferrante's Naples across four series; the Neapolitan is subtitled in Italian, which is itself the exercise.

pool.title: Il Commissario Ricciardi
pool.why: Naples in the 1930s with a commissario who hears the last words of the dead; de Giovanni's novels, slow and literate Italian.

pool.title: Màkari
pool.why: A writer back in his Sicilian village solves cases by the sea; lighter than Montalbano, the same coast.

pool.title: I Bastardi di Pizzofalcone
pool.why: A Naples squad of misfits, de Giovanni again; ensemble Italian with some dialect, one case across two episodes.

pool.title: Rocco Schiavone
pool.why: A Roman deputy chief exiled to Aosta, foul-mouthed and good; register practice for the Italian nobody teaches in class.

pool.title: Le indagini di Lolita Lobosco
pool.why: A woman police chief in Bari; Puglia light, Apulian colour in the Italian, and food in every episode.

pool.title: Un passo dal cielo
pool.why: Forest rangers and carabinieri in the Dolomites; the gentlest Rai crime series and the clearest Italian.

pool.title: Studio Battaglia
pool.why: Three sisters in a Milan divorce practice; fast, urban, upper-register Italian, the counterweight to the southern series.

pool.title: Petra
pool.why: Paola Cortellesi as a Genoa inspector; Blanca's city again, drier and more adult.

pool.title: Pechino Express
pool.why: The Italian race across Asia in pairs on a euro a day; Race Across the World with Italian arguing.

pool.title: Bake Off Italia
pool.why: The Italian tent, with Benedetta Parodi; the same format in a third language and pastry vocabulary you will use in Italy.

pool.title: Ulisse: il piacere della scoperta
pool.why: Alberto Angela's history and travel documentaries; the clearest spoken Italian on Rai and the deep cut's Italian cousin.

pool.title: Report
pool.why: Rai's investigative programme, Sigfrido Ranucci; dense current-affairs Italian and the stories Italian papers follow up on Monday.

pool.title: Il Paradiso delle Signore
pool.why: A 1960s Milan department-store daily drama; the easiest sustained Italian listening on television, one episode a day.

pool.title: Mare Fuori
pool.why: Teenagers in a Naples juvenile prison; the series Italian teenagers watch, and the Neapolitan of today.
